svg.aria-label: A 20,418-line pull request in Diffo, layered by Importance: organizations, roles and SSO across 214 files, opened alphabetical. The reviewer picks Importance under Layer by and asks the agent, which keeps 152 lines in five key layers, the deciding sections of each: the schema migration, the SSO sign-in, the roles and permission checks, the API routes that break, and the API keys it removed. UI, call sites, tests, fixtures and docs go to Other changes, folded.
